skill_domain: skill engineering edge cases, eval failure modes, oracle quality edge cases

findings.title: Adversarial Prompting and Prompt Injection in LLM Systems
findings.key_finding: LLM systems can be manipulated via carefully crafted inputs; eval systems are particularly vulnerable when the evaluation target is also an LLM; nested eval loops need isolation
findings.design_impact: Fixture 隔离原则（.tmp/eval/<skill>_<version>/）：防止 eval 产生的测试文件污染主目录

findings.title: Gaming and Shortcut Learning in LLM Benchmarks
findings.key_finding: LLMs can achieve high scores on benchmarks through surface-level pattern matching rather than genuine capability; judge_prompt verbosity bias is a systematic shortcut
findings.design_impact: failure-mode-first eval 设计哲学：先问「坏输出是什么」而不是「好输出有什么特征」

findings.title: The Oracle Problem in Software Testing
findings.source: Baresi & Young, 2001, International Conference on Software Engineering
findings.key_finding: The oracle problem: determining correct test outcomes is often as hard as solving the original problem; automated oracle generation is an open research problem
findings.design_impact: judge_calibration 是 oracle problem 的工程化解法：用已知样本对验证 oracle（judge_prompt）的区分力

top_insights: eval 系统本身是攻击面：judge_prompt 偏差、样本污染、嵌套 session 限制都是真实风险
only-increase 约束 + P2 归档 + judge_calibration 形成三层防御：防止 eval gaming
Fixture 隔离是 eval 准确性的基础设施，不是可选项

suggested_eval_cases.description: 嵌套 session 下 judge_calibration 自动 skip 而非报 FAIL（不阻断 eval）
